notes.title: Demo v25.9.8 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hey!

Thanks for all the feedback on the demo. I’m continuing development, and the first step is addressing some of the main frustrations you pointed out.
Patch Notes
Tile Numbers - Adjusted to give clearer information and reduce guesswork (RNG).

Corruption System - Removed “?” indicators to avoid confusion.

More improvements are on the way as development continues! I know there's still some other frustrations commented in the feedback, so I'll tackle those next.

Got more ideas? Join the conversation on Discord.
